metrics.arms: primary: pi05_base backbone detect_phrase; Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct bbox_phrase; Molmo-7B-D-0924 point_phrase. secondary: segment and instruction-context variants. supplementary: pi05_l90c@5000 backbone detect_phrase
metrics.bar: per (arm, config): held-out depth-1 hit >= 0.70 AND all depth-2 seen-body hit >= 0.70 AND depth-0 hit >= GroundingDINO (0.786); B0 PASS iff any primary config passes; caddy reported separately
metrics.conversion: box -> centre-token peak, coverage>=0.5 mask (B1a rule); segment -> decoded VQ mask, max-coverage peak; points -> S3b rule; unparseable -> miss
metrics.not_run: PaliGemma mix (google/paligemma-3b-mix-224, not the policy base) and PaliGemma pt-224 (google/paligemma-3b-pt-224, the policy base; coordinator amendment): gated, no local weights
metrics.pi05_rule: if the pi05 backbone emits no parseable <loc> output it is recorded as a finding (no prompt or decoding changes)
metrics.prompts: experiments/b0_vlm.py docstring (phrase verbatim from S1 labels; context variant adds the full instruction)
metrics.smoke: 6 TRAINING units: pi05_base emits fluent captions / yes-answers, no loc token, under all 4 prompts (recorded as found, no change); Qwen and Molmo parse 6/6 (Molmo context 5/6)
metrics.status: PRE-REGISTERED PLAN_BINDER B0 (pretrained VLM backbones as binders, offline screen)
metrics.units: S1's 240 dev units (results/bind/s1/labels.json), S1 hit metric (s1_read.hit), task-cluster bootstrap (d4_read.rate)
metrics.written_before: any B0 dev prediction or score
